objective: Build a voice interface CLI that uses Whisper (local) for STT, Piper TTS (local) for output, 16kHz mono, 2s silence timeout, interrupt support. CLI: viral-dev voice listen --timeout 30s. Include tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner objective is satisfied: Build a voice interface CLI that uses Whisper (local) for STT, Piper TTS (local) for output, 16kHz mono, 2s silence timeout, interrupt support. CLI: viral-dev voice listen --timeout 30s. Include tests.
Repository rules and current approved milestone boundaries are preserved.
Relevant automated verification passes and continuity state is updated.
notes: Created from the owner-facing viral-dev objective command.
Efficiency selection: EXECUTE / CODING_HARNESS / MEDIUM. Selected claude with MEDIUM effort because development work requires an authenticated coding harness and the selected harness is usable.

Duplicate of OBJ-20260911203148743: identical objective text, resubmitted after that task was already blocked. This is M05 Voice Interface work (Whisper STT, Piper TTS, `viral-dev voice listen`) auto-tagged under the current milestone M04_EFFICIENCY_GOVERNOR, which is already complete and whose own spec explicitly forbids voice or any M05 work. ROADMAP.md, AGENTS.md Scope Discipline, RULES.md, and DECISIONS.md D017 all reserve starting a later milestone to the owner. No implementation code was written.

Resubmitting the same objective text does not constitute owner approval to open M05. An explicit owner decision (e.g. a recorded DECISIONS.md entry approving M05) is required before either this task or OBJ-20260911203148743 can proceed.
Unblock path: the owner explicitly approves opening M05 (Voice Interface) as the active milestone, or re-scopes/cancels this objective.
Verified implementation committed as c842bebe008efb6a97362ccba0520939ac94c26c and pushed to origin/feat/m05-voice.
nextAction: Objective completed after verified changes were committed and pushed.
